Hi Sanjay / Priya,

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood — excited to get AuroraGrid an onramp demo next week. Before I lock time I wanted to confirm two things so we set the right audience:

1) Do you want this session to be a tactical product deep-dive or a strategic exec briefing? (We can do a ~45m exec presentation + 15m Q&A, or a 90m technical workshop.)
2) You mentioned looping in your CIO — can you confirm availability windows and whether they prefer a short pre-brief (10–15m) with our CRO ahead of the demo?

Proposed windows (PT): Tue 12/8 11:00–12:00, Wed 12/9 09:00–10:00, or Thu 12/10 14:00–15:00. I can provision a VP-level presence and our Solutions Architect (Karthik) for any of the slots.

Attaching a brief agenda and a suggested mutual action plan (stubbed files). If you want an NDA or a procurement contact included, let me know and I’ll loop them in.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear options. We want this to be an exec-facing session (strategic) but would also like a short technical Q&A at the end. Our CIO, Priya Menon, should attend; she prefers a morning slot.

Wed 12/9 09:00–10:00 PT works best for her. She asked for a 15-minute pre-brief with your leadership (CRO or head of platform) if possible; she usually appreciates a quick alignment call to set the context.

Also — please include a short appendix on data residency and how you handle private deployments; that will be a conversation starter.

- Sanjay
